title: W3C — tabs pattern
observed: A selected tab is connected to its visible panel. Horizontal tab lists use Left/Right arrows; manual activation uses Enter or Space.
application: Sol day selection, Roam plan previews and Kiln reporting periods use one active panel. Focus and selection are tracked separately.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: W3C — checkbox pattern
observed: A checkbox exposes its checked state and a readable label; Space toggles it.
application: Gather uses one native checkbox per person, with count and avatar summary derived from selected IDs.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: W3C — radio group pattern
observed: Radio groups express a single choice. Arrow keys move between options and Space selects.
application: Courtyard keeps exactly one active material, with a visible ring and its text name.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: W3C — modal dialog pattern
observed: A modal moves focus inside, contains keyboard focus, closes on Escape and returns focus appropriately.
application: Roam review and Kiln plan details need explicit close/cancel paths with trigger focus restoration.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: W3C — disclosure pattern
observed: A disclosure button exposes its expanded state and toggles a connected content region.
application: Gather opens by activation, not hover; its trigger communicates open or closed.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Radix — Popover build example
observed: The documented primitive includes controlled state, placement and collision handling, focus management and dismissal options.
application: Use a tested popover primitive for Gather and Sol options, retaining the existing material art and layout.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Radix — Toggle Group build example
observed: The example supports controlled state, single or multiple toggles, orientation and keyboard navigation.
application: A useful implementation reference for compact controls. Courtyard still uses radio semantics because it requires a choice.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Stripe — subscription pricing table
observed: The pricing table displays plans and takes a chosen option into Checkout. Completion is a separate step.
application: Roam previews and compares plans, then explicitly reviews the chosen price. Selection alone does not subscribe.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Supabase — usage documentation
observed: Usage documentation separates resource categories and explains what is measured and how it is calculated.
application: Kiln needs explicit units, denominator labels and category details. This is a structure reference, not a copied pricing model.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: W3C — complex images and charts
observed: Complex graphics need a short description plus a longer textual equivalent of their essential information.
application: Kiln exposes a data table and values in text; hover tooltips are supplemental.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: MDN — aria-current
observed: aria-current identifies the current item within a related set, including the current page.
application: Folio uses navigation links and aria-current="page" for routes. Use tabs only if switching local panels.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Apple — Weather guide
observed: The guide shows current conditions, forecast exploration, location selection and configurable weather units.
application: Sol retains a compact four-day surface, with unit conversion and a separately opened location control.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: React — choosing state structure
observed: React recommends avoiding contradictory, redundant and duplicated state.
application: Derive selected counts, button labels, usage totals and visible panels from stable IDs and shared data.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit

title: Motion — accessible animation
observed: Motion supports system reduced-motion preferences and replacing substantial movement with simpler feedback.
application: Disable object drift, parallax and transform flourishes under reduced motion; keep selection and focus feedback.
kind: official documentation; read, not a live product audit
